$description: Sovereign Editorial surface tokens — dark-mode chromatic-navy reading surface, category-tile accent palette, footer tokens, and the per-tenant brand-accent pattern. Registered from app-mediakit-knowledge Phase 2→Phase 6 wiki redesign (2026-06-20 to 2026-06-29); live on documentation.pointsav.com, projects.woodfinegroup.com, corporate.woodfinegroup.com. Source: project-knowledge DESIGN-RESEARCH-sovereign-editorial-knowledge-wiki draft. No content edits — values copied verbatim from the implemented CSS custom properties in app-mediakit-knowledge/static/style.css.

surface.$description: Dark-mode chromatic-navy surface — low chroma (0.04–0.05), hue 250/255. Warmer than pure neutral, cooler than blue. Matches Bloomberg/Reuters terminal aesthetic.

brand-accent.$description: Per-tenant accent pattern — one CSS custom property set via a `[data-instance]` attribute selector on the document root. Documented once here; applicable to every MediaKit engine (app-mediakit-knowledge, -marketing, -distributions) rather than re-declared per engine. Consuming CSS: `[data-instance="<tenant>"] { --brand-accent: <value>; }`.

category-tile.$description: 7-color accent palette for home-page category tiles (HOMEPAGE_CATEGORIES). Live in app-mediakit-knowledge server/mod.rs.
